templates.text: Sudden pressure on the sole → plantar grasp reflex, brief cessation of movement.
Light stroke along the lateral foot → Babinski sign, followed by a soft whimper.
Firm touch on the cheek → rooting reflex, head turns toward the stimulus.
A gentle tap on the palm → palmar grasp, fingers curl tightly for {seconds} seconds.
Cool surface against the back → startle-like arching, then a settling squirm.
Sustained touch on the abdomen → localized limb flexion, a short, sharp cry.
Rapid fingertip stroke up the spine → Galant reflex, torso curves toward the touch.
Brief pressure on the forehead → Moro reflex initiation, arms briefly abduct.
Repeated pat on the thigh → rhythmic leg kicking, followed by quieting.
Steady touch on the upper lip → sucking motions commence, eyes briefly close.
A dragging touch across the palm → grasp tightens, then releases with a sigh.
Localized pressure on the calf → foot dorsiflexes, a single vocalization follows.
Light brush on the eyelid → blink reflex, head turns away slightly.
Deep, steady pressure on the shoulder → muscle tone increases, movement stills.
Quick tap below the knee → patellar reflex, leg extends then retracts.
Circular rub on the temple → rooting search, mouth opens and closes.
Pinprick sensation on the heel → immediate withdrawal, a sharp, high-pitched cry.
Warm cloth placed on the chest → general calming, hands unclench.
Vibration against the sole → toes fan, leg pulls up in a defensive motion.
Grasp of a single finger → strong palmar hold, arm shows slight tonic neck posture.
Stroking from chin to lower lip → mouth opens wide in a rooting response.
Sudden release of foot pressure → leg extends fully, then relaxes.
Light tickle under the arm → arm adducts, a brief, breathy sound escapes.
Firm squeeze of the thigh → cry onset delayed by {seconds} second, then vigorous.
Steady touch on the nape → neck extends, body becomes momentarily rigid.
Rapid sequence of palm taps → alternating grasp and release, fussing builds.
Cold object on the abdomen → startle, hands fly to midline, cry follows.
Sustained pressure on the sole → toes curl downward, knee and hip flex.
Gentle traction on the grasped fingers → whole arm tension increases, pulling inward.
Localized rub on the back → Galant response, a soft coo accompanies the movement.
